Multiplicative nonarchimedean seminorms on algebras are specified locally; 00MD describes vector-space seminorms and is not the correct direct definition here.
A terminology comparison, not a prerequisite of integrable adelic line bundles. The actual definition is a tensor quotient of two nef objects.
The composed function is explicitly displayed, with both inner and outer functions given. No hidden construction is required to decode the expression.
Both pages link 0GK9, which defines the normalized U(N) Haar model and links 00T1; retain that specific probability-model entry.
The linked spectral definitions 0GS2 and 0GS8 lead to 0F0B and 0GSQ and specify the relevant Laplacian domain. A generic eigenvalue link would not supply additional missing assumptions.
The same outline links the exact matrix-spectrum condition 0H4P, which links 0F0B. These are narrative links rather than prerequisite edges of an outline.
